This folder is the whole application.

Everything it writes - config.properties, the certificate, credentials, logs and the downloaded
track library - stays in here, next to this file. That is what this file is for: the app checks for
it and keeps its data beside itself instead of under %LOCALAPPDATA%. Deleting it moves the data
folder; there is no reason to.

Start it with TraktorProxy.cmd, or run "Create shortcuts.cmd" once to get a desktop and Start menu
entry. TraktorProxy-console.cmd starts the same thing with the log in a visible window.

To upgrade, unzip a newer release over this folder. Only lib\ and the launchers are replaced, so
your settings and your library survive. To uninstall, quit from the tray and delete the folder
(turn off "Start with Windows" in the tray menu first, and remove the api.beatport.com line from
C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts).

Java 17 or newer has to be installed; this build carries no runtime of its own.
